habitat: 바다의 작은 무인도(번식지), 갯벌, 모래 해변

months.note: 3월 하순에 번식지에 도착해 7월 말에서 8월 초 사이에 떠난다.

summary: 우리나라에는 3월 하순에 와서 8월 초까지 머무는 드문 여름철새로, 2016년 4월 전남 영광 칠산도의 무인도 육산도에서 처음 확인되었고 이후 해마다 번식을 시도하고 있다. 괭이갈매기 번식지 안의 맨땅에 알을 1개 낳으며, 번식 전후에는 고창 등 가까운 해안의 갯벌과 모래 해변에서 쉰다. 번식지가 우리나라와 중국의 섬 몇 곳뿐인 세계적 멸종위기종(위급, CR)이다.

art.subject: Chinese Crested Tern (Thalasseus bernsteini), adult in breeding plumage, as seen at Korean west-coast island colonies in summer (June–July): full black cap from the bill base to the nape, ending in a short shaggy crest; rest of the head, neck and underparts white; mantle and upperwings very pale grey, almost whitish; outer primaries darker grey towards the tips; rump and tail white; bill orange-yellow with a broad black band near the end and a small pale yellow tip; dark eye; legs black.
art.pose: standing on bare rock at a breeding colony with the crest slightly raised, side view
art.scene: small rocky island off the Korean west coast in June, bare rock with sparse grass and grey-blue sea; no people, buildings or text
views: adult in breeding plumage, side view standing on bare rock with the crest slightly raised: full black crown from the bill base to the nape ending in a shaggy crest, white face and underparts, very pale silvery-grey back and folded wings, stout yellow bill with a black tip ending in a small white point, short legs

adult in breeding plumage, in flight seen squarely from above: head, body and tail in one line, long narrow wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span, the outer wing angled back from the wrist, very pale silvery-grey back and upperwing, black crown with a shaggy crest, yellow bill with a black tip
art.build: Medium-large tern, slightly smaller and slimmer than Greater Crested Tern and much larger than Common Tern, with long, narrow, pointed wings and a forked tail. Shaggy crest at the rear of the black cap. Bill long, straight and fairly stout, about as long as the head, sharply pointed. Legs short and black. At rest the wingtips extend a little beyond the tail tip. Flight buoyant on long, angled wings, the bill pointing down when searching for fish.
avoid: Do not paint a plain yellow bill without a black band; that is Greater Crested Tern (Thalasseus bergii), which also has a darker grey back and a white forehead band.
Do not paint a black bill with only a yellow tip; that is Sandwich Tern.
Do not paint red or orange legs; the legs are black.
Do not give it long tail streamers like Common Tern.
